findings.scenario: Observe whether Population in IPC/CH Phase 3 or above, famine classifications, price anomalies, and simultaneous production shocks moves in the direction of concern: More affected people, higher severity phases, simultaneous breadbasket shocks, or constrained access
findings.observationCadence: monthly situation scan and annual GRFC refresh
findings.measurableTrigger: A new famine classification, synchronized production anomaly, or major access deterioration
findings.boundedResponse: Build a public-data food dependency and correlated-shock map with explicit missing-data flags
findings.rollback: Quarantine unreliable feeds and restore the last verified dependency snapshot
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation may assemble and test public-data maps. Aid allocation, market participation, outreach, and procurement are external actions requiring bounded authorization; a human is contacted only when automation proves it cannot obtain necessary consent or exercise a legally reserved authority.
